content.text: The insurance clause meets the preferred position in full.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 obliges Vendor to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O of USD 2M and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M, maintained through the term plus one year — matching the preferred position (and exceeding it with employer's liability cover). Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, primacy, cancellation notice and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. Obligations run against Vendor and benefit us, so no redline is warranted.
